Hello — I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **Chat accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **My own web accounts** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with? Also: my name and grammatical form aren't set yet — "Professor Alvarez", and neither male nor female (they/it) unless you prefer otherwise. Tell me what to use and I'll set it.
